( #{item.USER_ID}, #{item.USER_NO}, #{item.USER_PWD}, #{item.USER_NM}, #{item.DGTL_DSC_CD}, #{item.USER_BTHD}, #{item.GND_CL_CD}, #{item.USER_OPOS_CD}, #{item.USER_CPOS_CD}, #{item.USER_CHRG_JOB_CTNT}, #{item.WRC_TELNO1}, #{item.WRC_TELNO2}, #{item.USER_MPNO}, #{item.USER_STAT_CD}, NULLIF(#{item.PWD_CHG_DTTM}, '')::timestamp, /* 빈 문자열 방지 및 형변환 */ #{item.HR_INFO_MTCH_CL_CD}, #{item.MPNO_OTTP_YN}, #{item.PLBK_BLG_NM}, #{item.USER_GVOF_CD}, #{item.ESRM_GVOF_CD}, 'SYS_BAT_PN02', /* 배치 시스템 식별 ID */ NOW(), 'SYS_BAT_PN02', NOW() )
